description: Find step-by-step replacement guides (battery, SSD, RAM, keyboard, fan and more) and their slugs; it returns summaries only, so call get_repair_guide with a slug to read the steps. For part numbers rather than procedures use get_model_parts. Filters combine with AND: model is resolved like get_model_parts (an ambiguous name returns candidates, an unknown one an error); component must appear in the guide's component or slug; every query word must appear in the title, slug or model name (case-insensitive substrings). With no filters it lists all guides (large). not_covered lists topics with no published steps, filtered by model and component only. Guides are paraphrased from official service manuals, not bench-tested. Read-only. Formerly find_repair_guides, which still works.

model.description: Optional model slug or full name, e.g. "hp-elitebook-840-g6" or "HP EliteBook 840 G6".

query.description: Optional words, all required, e.g. "bottom cover".

name: search_repair_guides

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Search repair guides
